payload.goal: Optimization technique for NVIDIA Blackwell (SM100): Practical Experience

problem.statement: TMA Gather Sparse Decode -- Practical Experience

payload.what: - TMA Gather combines multiple TMA copies into one, reducing TMA unit scheduling overhead - The number of tokens for Gather is typically 4 (SM100 hardware limit), matching TMA bandwidth - Applicable to all non-contiguous access patterns: sparse attention, paged KV cache, token selection - TMEM moves the accumulator out of the register file, freeing up a large number of VGPRs for scalar operations like softmax - Dual GEMM mode is suitable for scenarios with small head_dim (e.g., MLA's head_dim=64)
